subject.title: Feature: Configurable Permissions-Policy and CSP headers for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw add a typed, directive-limited Control UI header policy config for CSP and Permissions-Policy, or keep fixed hardened headers and direct custom local UI integrations to same-origin plugin/proxy surfaces?
rationale: The missing config surface is clear from source, but the requested knobs can weaken browser permissions, CSP connect-src, script policy, and framing boundaries if implemented too broadly.

options.title: Approve narrow typed policy config
options.body: Add only maintainer-approved directives with strict validation, generated schema/help/docs, and tests for default and opt-in policies.

options.title: Reject header configurability
options.body: Keep fixed hardened headers and document supported same-origin plugin or reverse-proxy paths for custom local UI integrations.

options.title: Split Permissions-Policy first
options.body: Address only a small microphone/permission policy subset and leave CSP connect-src customization for a separate design thread.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow typed policy config
recommendation.body: Add only maintainer-approved directives with strict validation, generated schema/help/docs, and tests for default and opt-in policies.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the best available owner from recent Control UI CSP/security-header history and because the open question is a security-boundary/product policy choice.
